-- Deviation: the stock FCF_ChatTabFadeFinished (FloatingChatFrame.lua:989-992) nils -- oldAlpha even under a live hover, so leaving and re-entering within -- CHAT_FRAME_FADE_TIME (a flick to the scroll buttons, outside the hover box, does it) -- stops the plate fading in (l.873) for the rest of the session; this keeps oldAlpha while -- hover is set. if FCF_ChatTabFadeFinished then function FCF_ChatTabFadeFinished(chatTab, chatFrame) chatTab:Hide() if not chatFrame.hover then chatFrame.oldAlpha = nil end end end
-- Deviation: re-runs UIParent_ManageFramePositions after DurabilityFrame's own OnEvent. The -- pass seats the frame 20 further in while a side glyph shows (UIParent.lua:1759-1768), -- but the stock frame runs it only from OnShow/OnHide, so a glyph appearing while the frame -- is shown leaves the shield's overhang off the screen edge. The stock handler runs first, -- unchanged, on the this/event/arg1 already set for the dispatch. if DurabilityFrame then local refOnEvent = DurabilityFrame:GetScript("OnEvent") DurabilityFrame:SetScript("OnEvent", function() if refOnEvent then refOnEvent() end UIParent_ManageFramePositions() end) end
-- Deviation: friendly plates the player turned on come back at every world entry. The -- stock UpdateNameplates (UIOptionsFrame.lua:768-780) shows them and hides them again at -- once (l.775-776), and FRIENDNAMEPLATES_ON is never saved, since l.182 registers -- NAMEPLATES_ON a second time. function UpdateNameplates() if ( NAMEPLATES_ON ) then ShowNameplates() else HideNameplates() end if ( FRIENDNAMEPLATES_ON ) then ShowFriendNameplates() else HideFriendNameplates() end end RegisterForSave("FRIENDNAMEPLATES_ON")
-- Deviation: negotiated aura overflow UI, built into this fork; stock FrameXML stays intact. -- This is original addon code, independent of the game's Interface files. local PAGE_SIZE = 36 local MAX_DEBUFFS = 255 local panels
local function Refresh(panel) local count = 0 for index = 1, MAX_DEBUFFS do if not UnitDebuff(panel.unit, index) then break end count = index end if count <= panel.legacySlots then panel:Hide() return end panel:Show() local pages = math.max(1, math.floor((count - panel.legacySlots + PAGE_SIZE - 1) / PAGE_SIZE)) panel.page = math.min(panel.page, pages) panel.label:SetText(panel.unit.." debuffs "..(panel.legacySlots + 1).."-"..count.." "..panel.page.."/"..pages) for i = 1, PAGE_SIZE do local button = panel.buttons[i] button.index = panel.legacySlots + (panel.page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE + i local icon, stacks = UnitDebuff(panel.unit, button.index) if icon then button.icon:SetTexture(icon) button.count:SetText(stacks and stacks > 1 and stacks or "") button:Show() else button:Hide() end end end
local function Panel(unit, legacySlots, anchor) local panel = CreateFrame("Frame", "BenillaExtendedAuras_"..unit, UIParent) panel.unit = unit panel.page = 1 panel.legacySlots = legacySlots panel.buttons = {} panel:SetWidth(244) panel:SetHeight(98) if unit == "player" then panel:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", anchor or UIParent, "BOTTOMRIGHT", 0, -12) else panel:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", anchor or UIParent, "BOTTOMLEFT", 5, -40) end panel.label = panel:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormalSmall") panel.label:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", panel, "TOPLEFT", 0, 0) for i = 1, PAGE_SIZE do local button = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaExtendedAuras_"..unit.."_"..i, panel) button.unit = unit button:SetWidth(18) button:SetHeight(18) button:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", panel, "TOPLEFT", math.mod(i - 1, 12) * 20, -18 - math.floor((i - 1) / 12) * 20) button.icon = button:CreateTexture(nil, "ARTWORK") button.icon:SetAllPoints(button) button.count = button:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormalSmall") button.count:SetPoint("BOTTOMRIGHT", button, "BOTTOMRIGHT", 0, 0) button:SetScript("OnEnter", function() GameTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetUnitDebuff(this.unit, this.index) end) button:SetScript("OnLeave", function() GameTooltip:Hide() end) panel.buttons[i] = button end local previous = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaExtendedAuras_"..unit.."_Previous", panel) previous:SetWidth(24) previous:SetHeight(18) previous:SetPoint("BOTTOMLEFT", panel, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, 0) local label = previous:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormalSmall") label:SetAllPoints(previous) label:SetText("<") previous:SetScript("OnClick", function() panel.page = math.max(1, panel.page - 1) Refresh(panel) end) local next = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaExtendedAuras_"..unit.."_Next", panel) next:SetWidth(24) next:SetHeight(18) next:SetPoint("BOTTOMLEFT", panel, "BOTTOMLEFT", 28, 0) label = next:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormalSmall") label:SetAllPoints(next) label:SetText(">") next:SetScript("OnClick", function() panel.page = panel.page + 1 Refresh(panel) end) panel:SetScript("OnEvent", function() if event == "PLAYER_TARGET_CHANGED" and panel.unit == "target" then panel.page = 1 end if event == "UNIT_AURA" and arg1 ~= panel.unit then return end Refresh(panel) end) panel:RegisterEvent("UNIT_AURA") panel:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_AURAS_CHANGED") panel:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_TARGET_CHANGED") panel:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD") Refresh(panel) return panel end
-- Called by the aura feed only after a valid server snapshot. No addon registry or install step. function BenillaExtendedAurasUpdate() if not panels then panels = {Panel("player", 8, BuffFrame), Panel("target", 16, TargetFrame)} end for _, panel in ipairs(panels) do Refresh(panel) end end
